subject: gk
question: As per Amendment of article 51A clause (k) said, “who is a parent or guardian to provide opportunities for education to his child or, as the case may be, ward between the age of _________ years.”
solution:
The correct answer is__** 6 to 14 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 51A(k):-

 
 
• It was inserted in the Constitution by the 86th Amendment Act, of 2002.
 
• It is a **fundamental duty** of every citizen of India, who is a parent or guardian, to provide opportunities for education to their child or ward between the **ages of six and fourteen years**.
 
 
 
• (Eighty-sixth Amendment) Act, 2002:-
 
 
• The **86th Amendment Act** was inserted as **21A in Article 21 in 2002**, which tells about the **right to education**.
 
• It became the fundamental right for children between 6-14 years.
 
• As per this amendment, the state shall provide free and compulsory education to** 6 to 14 years** in such a manner as the state may by law determine.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Right to education: "21A.

 
 
• The State shall provide free and compulsory education to all children of the age of six to fourteen years in such manner as the State may, by law, determine.".
 
• Substitution of new article for **article 45**.- For article 45 of the Constitution, the following article shall be substituted, namely Provision for early childhood care and education to children below the age of six years."
 
• The State shall endeavor to provide early childhood care and education for all children until they complete the age of six years."
 
• Amendment of **article 51A**.- In article 51A of the Constitution, after clause (J), the following clause shall be added, namely:-"(k) who is a parent or guardian to provide opportunities for education to his child or, as the case may be, ward between the age of six and fourteen years."
